blocks.title: DSA Algorithmic Problem Solving (2 Problems)

blocks.details: QA: 25 Questions on Averages: Batting averages, student age replacements, and consecutive integer sets averages.. DILR: Circular Arrangements 2 (Facing inward and outward mixed). Solve Anastasis Shankar Set 6 & Set 7..

blocks.details: Read 1 essay on Art / Science from Aeon. Practice Parajumbles without options (TITA format) on Cracku Daily Target. Maintain error log on Career Launcher MyZone.
